hints.content: A prime number has exactly two factors: $1$ and itself.

The factors of $35$ are $1, 5, 7,$ and $35.$

$35$ has $4$ factors so it is **not** a prime number.

The factors of $47$ are $1$ and $47.$

$47$ has **exactly** two factors so it is a prime number.

The factors of $55$ are $1, 5, 11,$ and $55.$

$55$ has $4$ factors so it is **not** a prime number.

The factors of $60$ are $1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 10, 12, 15, 20, 30,$ and $60.$

$60$ has $12$ factors so it is **not** a prime number.

The factors of $87$ are $1, 3, 29,$ and $87.$

$87$ has $4$ factors so it is **not** a prime number.
